title: Console glance: refine compact-density toggle motion and edge-state polish
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Polish the compact/expanded density toggle and the micro-motion behaviors in the Console Glance widget. This ticket covers final visual redlines, animation timing adjustments, accessibility reduced-motion behavior, handoff artifacts for engineering, and a short QA checklist for release. Goal: reduce perceived layout shift, improve clarity of collapsed states, and ensure motion performs on low-power machines.
acceptance_criteria: Figma final frames for compact and expanded states with annotated transition timings published
Design tokens and motion variables (duration/easing) added to handoff spec
Accessibility: reduced-motion and contrast checks validated
Engineering has accepted the handoff PR and confirmed render performance on a 4-core VM
QA checklist passed in staging with no layout-flash regressions
qa_notes: Test toggle at 320/768/1366 widths to ensure icon alignment doesn't overflow
Simulate CPU throttling in Chrome DevTools (4x) and verify animation stays below 120ms to avoid jank
Verify focus states and keyboard toggle behavior (Tab + Space/Enter) in both modes
Confirm aria-expanded updates and that screen reader announces state change clearly
review_comments: 2026-02-25 - Marco: Prefer slightly faster expansion timing than collapse; users expect snappy expansion for overview cards.
2026-02-27 - Riley: Research suggests opacity+translate performs best on low-end GPUs; avoid animating layout height when possible.
2026-03-02 - Jordan: Need explicit motion token names (motion.duration.short/medium) so runtime can map to CSS variables or reveal-runner constants.
2026-03-04 - Priya: Confirmed trimmed DOM approach: use max-height clip + transform to avoid reflow on resize-heavy pages.
2026-03-08 - Accessibility review (internal): Add reduced-motion preference handling and ensure contrast delta for collapsed label meets AA
decisions: Use translateY + opacity for collapse/expand instead of animating height to minimize layout thrashing
Standardize durations: expand 160ms (cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .2, 1)), collapse 120ms (ease-out) based on stakeholder preference
Add a CSS motion token 'motion.duration.glance-compact' mapped to runtime value so engineers can tune per-deployment
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: collapse/expand will cross-fade with no translate when preference is set
Keep 8px baseline grid and 12px minimum touch target for density controls; icon-only toggle gets accessible label
next_steps: Finalize Figma frames with redlines and token table (Evelyn) - due 2026-03-14
Create handoff PR with CSS tokens + short animation demo page (Jordan) - estimated 2 days
Run accessibility sweep and attach screenshots to ticket (Riley) - before engineering sign-off
Schedule 30m sync with ENG on 2026-03-15 to confirm runtime mapping and release gating
